protocol.name: mae_available_at_t
protocol.text: A decision at t uses only information available at t. Ground truth is read only after a successful measurement, for rewards when those rewards are disclosed, and for evaluation. It is not an input to assignment or to the predictor.
protocol.shared_environment: Methods that share scenario, subset, time range, and seed also share the noise field, trajectories, initial observations, machine pool, measurement-noise draws, and acceptance draws. Budget does not resample that environment. Algorithm exploration uses a separate seed.

metric_definitions.mae_causal: Historical column name for mae_available_at_t. Mean absolute error of the IDW predictor at each evaluation slot, using only observations with slot <= t. Truth is the evaluation target, not a model input.
metric_definitions.mae_available_at_t: Same number as mae_causal. Decision-time protocol: information available at t only.
metric_definitions.rmse_causal: Root mean squared error under the same decision-time protocol.
metric_definitions.coverage: Fraction of grids with at least one successful sample during the evaluation horizon.
metric_definitions.sampling_cost: Sum of participant costs of successful samples. Rejected or missed tasks are refunded when replanning is enabled.
metric_definitions.interval_coverage: Empirical frequency with which truth falls inside mean ± 1.96 predictive std. This checks the uncertainty, it does not prove calibration.
